links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT responses to cataract FAQs versus Google
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were significantly longer and written at a higher reading level than Google (p < .001), with average grade level 14.8 (college level).
links.quote: Responses to 20 patient FAQs generated by ChatGPT were significantly longer and written at a higher reading level than responses provided by Google (p < .001), with an average grade level of 14.8 (college level).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, safety, and readability of ChatGPT vs. Google for answering patient FAQs regarding cataract surgery offline without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
